title: Dates on Jobs - Job Tracker
description:
LIKE & SUBSCRIBE for you more Resume, Job Search & Career Growth content!

Managing dates for your job applications can drastically improve your organization and ensure you never miss a deadline!  In this video, I’ll guide you through the key date parameters in the Job Tracker, helping you stay on top of your job search.

What We Will Cover:
- How to manage the saved date and its importance 
- Manually adding the date posted 
- Understanding application deadlines 
- The importance of the applied date and how it updates automatically 
- Utilizing followup dates as reminders 
- Overview of tracking and sorting dates in the Job Tracker 

Questions Answered in This Video:
- What are the key date parameters in the Job Tracker?
- How do I add and manage dates for my job applications?
- What does the followup feature do and how can it help me?
- How can I sort and view all my application dates easily?
- When should I expect to set and use interview dates?
